Nielsen's Media Distributor Gauge—TV screens only, YouTube TV excluded—put YouTube at thirteen point four percent of U.S. television usage in July twenty-twenty-five.
Disney: nine point four. Netflix: eight point eight.
YouTube said in September twenty-twenty-five it paid out more than one hundred billion dollars to creators, artists, and media companies over the prior four years.
